crossRefs.note: There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.
Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.
His mouth was smooth as butter, but his heart was war. His words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.
My soul is among lions. I lie among those who are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows…
What will be given to you, and what will be done more to you, you deceitful tongue?
Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.
They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent. Viper’s poison is under their lips.
“They bend their tongue, as their bow, for falsehood. They have grown strong in the land, but not for truth; for they…
Their tongue is a deadly arrow. It speaks deceit. One speaks peaceably to his neighbor with his mouth, but in his…

parallels.note: “You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.

translations.web: A man who gives false testimony against his neighbor is like a club, a sword, or a sharp arrow.
translations.bsb: Like a club or sword or sharp arrow is a man who bears false witness against his neighbor.
translations.kjv: A man that beareth false witness against his neighbour is a maul, and a sword, and a sharp arrow.
translations.asv: A man that beareth false witness against his neighbor Is a maul, and a sword, and a sharp arrow.
